hook: Your sunset in Dubai can happen twice in one evening.
title: Watch the Same Sunset Twice in Dubai
description:
At the Burj Khalifa in Dubai you can watch the sun set from the ground, ride the elevator up, and see it set again from the top. The tower is 828 metres tall, so the horizon drops as you rise. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #BurjKhalifa #Dubai
